**About Acadia Pharmaceuticals
** Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome.
We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.
**Please note that this position is based in either San Diego, CA, or Princeton, NJ. Acadia's hybrid model requires this role to work in our office three days per week on average.
** Position Summary
The Executive Director, P&P Technology & Operations will define and deliver the future-state blueprint for how P&P operations, technology, data, automation and self-service work together as Acadia grows.
This leader will simplify processes, expand self-service, automate repeatable work and create an integrated technology and service delivery ecosystem. The role will also establish Acadia’s enterprise People Intelligence capability, turning trusted workforce data into actionable insights for leaders.
The successful candidate will operate as a strategist, architect and hands-on transformation leader, translating the future state into a sequenced roadmap and measurable business, employee and operational outcomes.
**Primary Responsibilities
** P&P Operating Model & Service Delivery

...

* Build a multiyear roadmap that balances immediate improvements with longer-term transformation.
Process Simplification, Automation & Employee Experience

...

P&P Technology Strategy & Governance
* Own the enterprise P&P technology strategy, architecture and roadmap, including Workday and the broader technology ecosystem.
* Establish product governance for prioritization, investment, design standards, releases, security, testing and adoption.
* Partner with IT, Finance, Legal and other functions to deliver integrated, scalable solutions and evaluate emerging technology based on value, risk, user experience and total cost.
People Intelligence & Workforce Insights
* Establish Acadia’s People Intelligence capability by connecting workforce, talent, organization, engagement, performance, recruiting, learning, compensation and planning data.
* Create a scalable data and analytics strategy with clear architecture, definitions, quality standards, ownership and governance.
* Deliver executive and manager insights on workforce trends, organizational health, talent risks and business performance.
* Advance reporting toward predictive and prescriptive insights, applying AI and advanced analytics where they improve decision quality and speed.
* Partner with Finance, IT and business leaders to connect people insights with enterprise planning and investment decisions.
Transformation Execution & Team Leadership
* Translate strategy into a focused portfolio with clear outcomes, milestones, resources, owners and measures of success.
* Lead implementation, change, adoption, testing, training and stabilization for major operational and technology initiatives.
* Manage portfolio tradeoffs, dependencies, risks and investments with transparent governance.
* Build and lead a high-performing P&P Operations, Technology and People Analytics team, while effectively managing vendors and implementation partners.
Measures of Success

...

* Greater business value from Workday and the broader P&P technology ecosystem.
* A clear, prioritized and effectively governed transformation portfolio that redirects P&P capacity to higher-value work.
**Education, Experience & Skills
**
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Significant progressive experience leading P&P operations, HR technology, service delivery, people analytics or enterprise transformation, including multidisciplinary teams.
* Demonstrated success transforming an HR operating model, shared-services capability or enterprise service delivery ecosystem and converting a future-state blueprint into a sequenced roadmap.
* Track record simplifying and automating employee-lifecycle processes and implementing workflow, self-service and AI-enabled solutions.
* Deep experience with Workday and related service delivery, knowledge, case management, integration and workflow technologies.
* Demonstrated success building people analytics or workforce intelligence capabilities that integrate multiple data sources into executive-ready insights and support workforce planning.
* Strong product, portfolio and program leadership, with advanced analytical and business acumen and the ability to build business cases and prioritize investments.
* Ability to influence executives and partner across P&P, IT, Finance, Legal and the business; strong vendor, implementation, change and benefit-realization capabilities.
* Comprehensive knowledge of employment compliance, data privacy, information security and governance. Experience in a fast-paced, growing and highly regulated environment preferred.
**Physical Requirements
** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, see, talk or hear in a standard office environment and independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.
Ability to travel by car or airplane independently overnight up to 40% of the time and work after hours if required by travel schedule or business issues.

A growing custom manufacturer in the greater Salem area is seeking an experienced **Vice President of Operations** to lead and strengthen its manufacturing organization.
Post-acquisition, the company is entering an important stage of growth and is investing in the people, processes, technology, and operational capabilities needed to increase efficiency, throughput, and scalability.
Reporting directly to the CEO, the VP of Operations will oversee production, fabrication, quality, safety, maintenance, warehousing, and shipping while driving throughput, on-time delivery, and continuous improvement.
This is a highly hands-on leadership role, with most of the VP’s time spent on the production floor understanding the operation, developing leaders, analyzing performance, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to make a meaningful mark on a growing business, bringing fresh ideas to the operation and helping shape how it evolves. With significant growth ahead, this leader will have the opportunity to build an operation that is stronger, more scalable, and positioned for the future.
**What You'll Do**
* Lead day-to-day manufacturing and custom fabrication operations, driving performance across production, quality, safety, throughput, and on-time delivery.
* Maintain a strong presence on the production floor, using firsthand observation and Gemba walks to understand workflow, identify constraints, and uncover opportunities for improvement.
* Establish and manage production planning, scheduling, capacity, and operating rhythms that create greater visibility and accountability throughout the operation.
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and other continuous improvement practices to improve flow, reduce waste and rework, increase throughput, and strengthen manufacturing processes.
* Develop supervisors and managers through hands-on coaching, clear expectations, and accountability, strengthening both team performance and operational execution.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve scalability and reduce reliance on labor through process improvements, automation, equipment, and strategic capital investment.
* Partner closely with the CEO, executive leadership, and Board on operational strategy, growth initiatives, capital investments, and the infrastructure needed to support continued expansion.
**What You Bring**
* 10+ years of manufacturing operations experience, including 5+ years in senior leadership over a full plant or multiple departments.
* Proven experience in custom fabrication or engineered-to-order manufacturing; metal fabrication experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success using Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or equivalent continuous improvement methods to deliver measurable operational results.
* Strong command of production scheduling, capacity planning, and throughput management.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing safety and quality systems.
* Proven track record of coaching and developing supervisors and managers into higher levels of responsibility, while building strong relationships, maintaining accountability, and influencing teams through a constructive leadership style.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, manufacturing, business, or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience in pre-engineered metal buildings, structural steel, or heavy fabrication; Lean/Six Sigma certification; ERP/Excel reporting; machine programming; or Spanish fluency are pluses.
* Willingness to work fully on-site in the greater Salem area.
_Our client offers a strong base plus performance-based bonus, employer-paid base-level medical coverage, voluntary dental and vision benefits, PTO, and paid holidays._

  Executive

  Full-time
* Industries
  Manufacturing
